jobs.description:
Trail Drive Management Corp is seeking a full-time 24/7 Security Officer to protect our Fort Worth venues. This on-site role includes patrols, access control, incident reporting, and coordination with the Security Supervisor.

The ideal candidate has 3+ years in security or related fields, valid Texas driver’s license, and the ability to obtain a Texas Guard Card; bilingual English/Spanish is a plus. CPR/first aid skills are expected.

jobs.description:

Qualified candidates should be 18+, have a HS diploma or GED, and be eligible for Texas security registration. The role requires independence, teamwork, and availability for nights, weekends, and holidays.
